Music Sync Web - audio separation frontend and bundled helper notices

This file preserves upstream license/NOTICE texts. Component headings describe their provenance; they do not replace the license terms. ONNX Runtime itself and its native third-party notices are supplied separately in ../onnxruntime/. Model-weight licenses/provenance are supplied separately under ../../models/.

The four frontend packages are listed with their installed npm versions. Optional ORT WebGL helper versions below come from the official onnxruntime v1.31.1 js/web/package-lock.json and the shipped ort.webgl.min.mjs source map, not unrelated versions resolved in this app. Their static chunk is shipped by the bundler; Music Sync supplies its own WebGPU/WASM session.

ORT build dependency source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/v1.31.1/js/web/package-lock.json

==============================================================================

@audio/neural-separate 0.7.0 - original published NOTICE
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@audio/neural-separate/-/neural-separate-0.7.0.tgz
Integrity: sha512-eTrUVgu6/tFMx5nI67qAtNSbKv4LmG4NNgX2R8T0EPu4D8QtAz/KA2/edxJ2sWQ0XxhuRFmnJH2m3unrCODI4A==
Declared license: MIT
Source file: package/NOTICE (verbatim; includes translated upstream attributions and their MIT terms)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
@audio/neural-separate
Copyright 2026 Dmitry Iv. and audiojs contributors

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of open-unmix-pytorch
(https://github.com/sigsep/open-unmix-pytorch) and norbert (https://github.com/sigsep/norbert):
filtering.py's multichannel Wiener filter and its expectation-maximization, with their defaults,
and model.Separator's 300-frame windowing, into separate.js. Both under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) 2019 Inria (Fabian-Robert Stöter, Antoine Liutkus)

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of Demucs
(https://github.com/facebookresearch/demucs): apply.apply_model's segment overlap-add and
htdemucs.py's spectrogram framing, into separate.js. Under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of Music-Source-Separation-Training
(https://github.com/ZFTurbo/Music-Source-Separation-Training): utils/model_utils.py's demix(),
its segments, fades and reflection, into separate.js. Under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) 2024 Roman Solovyev (ZFTurbo)

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of cocktail-fork-separation
(https://github.com/merlresearch/cocktail-fork-separation): mrx.py's three STFTs, masks and iSTFTs, and
separate.py's input loudness, into separate.js. Under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) 2023 Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL)

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of TIGER (https://github.com/JusperLee/TIGER):
look2hear/models/tiger_dnr.py's TIGERDNR.wav_chunk_inference, its segments and their sum, into separate.js.
Under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) 2026 Kai Li

This product includes a JavaScript translation of parts of pyloudnorm
(https://github.com/csteinmetz1/pyloudnorm): meter.py's integrated loudness and iirfilter.py's K-weighting
coefficients, into separate.js. Under the MIT License:

    Copyright (c) 2018 Christian Steinmetz

The MIT License, for each notice above:

    Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this
    software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software
    without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge,
    publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software, and to permit persons
    to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

    The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or
    substantial portions of the Software.

    THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED,
    INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR
    PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE
    FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR
    OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER
    DEALINGS IN THE SOFTWARE.

No model weights are included. The export scripts write them to the local cache, and the compact
files of SCNet-large, SCNet, MRX and TIGER are fetched from huggingface.co/audiojs (scnet-large, scnet,
mrx, tiger-dnr, each with its licence and model card); their terms are their authors' (Open-Unmix
umxhq: MIT; SCNet and SCNet-large: MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 starrytong, redistributable converted with
attribution, github.com/starrytong/SCNet/issues/35; Demucs htdemucs
weights: see the README; MRX: MIT, Copyright 2023 Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL), the
repository's .reuse/dep5 naming each checkpoint; TIGER's DnR model: Apache 2.0, its model card,
huggingface.co/JusperLee/TIGER-DnR).
